# SAY-19 — Touring DJ Operations (DJ Sayd Genuinely New Disciplines)

```
Flagship of the SAY-11→20/38/41/42/45/46→50 external market-general
cluster (task #188). Prerequisite: SAY-11→18 (DJ foundations,
technical skills, performance — market-general, no prerequisite
certification gate defined in this cluster).
```

## Grounding

Real market-standard discipline: touring operations specific to a
performing DJ (routing, equipment logistics, technical rider,
set-to-set travel). **Worked example** cited by reference, never
re-derived: FMS-05 ("Management d'artiste," 32h), specifically module
`FMS-05-M04` ("Tour management — logistique et budget," `backend/
seed_modules.py`) — deliverable "Tourbook complet 5 dates." FMS-05's
tour-management content is generalist (any touring artist); this
formation cites it for the transferable logistics/budget pedagogy and
builds only the DJ-specific material FMS-05 does not cover (equipment/
technical-rider logistics unique to DJ sets, back-to-back/multi-venue
routing at festival scale).

## Prerequisites

SAY-11→18 (DJ foundations, technical skills, performance).

## Objectives

1. Build a DJ-specific tourbook, citing `FMS-05-M04`'s real
   deliverable format (tourbook, budget) as the worked example, never
   re-deriving the general tour-management/budget pedagogy from
   scratch.
2. Add the genuinely DJ-specific material FMS-05 does not cover:
   equipment/technical-rider logistics (what gear travels, what is
   provided by the venue, backline requirements specific to DJ sets)
   and multi-venue/back-to-back festival routing.
3. Never re-teach FMS-05-M04's general tour-logistics/budget content
   verbatim — cite it, then build only the DJ-specific delta.

## Modules

| # | Module | Real grounding | Deliverable |
|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | Tour-management foundation | `FMS-05-M04` (worked example, cited) | DJ tourbook for a sample 5-date run, citing the FMS-05 format |
| M2 | Technical-rider & equipment logistics | Standard DJ-industry practice (market-general) | Technical rider specifying gear/backline requirements |
| M3 | Multi-venue / back-to-back festival routing | Standard DJ-industry practice (market-general) | Routing plan for a multi-venue festival weekend |

## Assessment

Per `../../CERTIFICATION_MODEL.md`. N2 includes a case testing whether
the candidate re-teaches `FMS-05-M04`'s general content verbatim
instead of citing it and adding the DJ-specific delta.

## Evidence / certification / mission eligibility

Evidence = M1 tourbook + M2 technical rider + M3 routing plan, all
checkable against `FMS-05-M04`'s cited real deliverable format and
standard DJ-touring practice. Certification eligibility: pass
Assessment at N2+. Mission eligibility: none — no real touring-DJ
role exists to staff through this Academy.
